query: how much did we bring in last month
note: temporal resolution. Also a near miss with get_balance, which is point in time not period.

query: what's sitting in the account right now
note: pair with g001. Balance is point in time, transactions is a period.

query: Bill jane@acme.com 50 dollars for March consulting
note: create, not send. Sending is a separate call. Classic near miss.

query: the acme invoice is ready, push it out to them
note: pair with g003. Requires resolving an invoice id first, so a correct run may be multi step.

query: nudge everyone who hasn't paid the March invoices yet
note: third member of the invoicing triple. Plural target may require a list call first.

query: give that customer their money back
note: no capture id, no customer. Must ask, must not guess a refund tool and invent an id.

query: refund the 1,250.50 capture from the Henderson order
note: decimal with comma separator. Near miss with dispute resolution.

query: Is there a dispute open from user_123?
note: opaque id. May need a lookup to map user_123 to a payer id. Accept either a filtered list or a lookup then list.

query: set up a 20 dollar monthly plan for premium members
note: creating the plan template, not enrolling anyone.

query: sign maria up for the premium monthly plan
note: pair with g009. Lexically similar, different tool. This pair is the single best test in the file.

query: pause the Henderson subscription, don't kill it
note: suspend vs cancel. The negation is the signal.

query: invoice acme for 400, then send it and note it in the March report
note: three steps. Score on first tool plus whether the plan enumerates the sequence.

query: find everyone who owes us money and remind them
note: read then write. Approval gate must fire before the reminder batch.

query: how long do buyers have to open a dispute after paying
note: policy question. Must route to docs, not to the disputes API.

query: what can you do with invoices
note: capability query. Renders registry results as prose, does not bind them.

query: did that last thing i asked for actually go through
note: queries the trace store, not the registry. Terse and lowercase on purpose.

query: pull up invoice INV2-3XKL-9QRT-8MMD
note: exact token retrieval. BM25 should carry this one, dense alone often will not.

query: anything more than 90 days overdue
note: no domain noun at all. Tests whether context or filters carry it.

query: what happened with order 8XR44219YT9012345
note: vague verb, precise id.

query: did the refund to Kowalski actually clear
note: near miss with refund_capture. This is a read, not a new refund. Dangerous confusion.

query: show me the euro transactions from Q1
note: fiscal period plus currency filter. Q1 of which year is itself ambiguous, accept current year.

query: which cards do we have saved for CUST-77104
note: vault domain is thinly represented, tests retrieval on a sparse corner.

query: status on the payout batch from friday
note: relative weekday. May need a list call first if no batch id is in state.

query: cancel invoice INV2-8HHM-2PQR-4KLZ, client backed out
note: cancel a sent invoice, not delete a draft. Approval gate should fire.

query: mark the Delgado invoice paid, they wired us directly
note: recording an external payment, not capturing one. Common wrong answer is capture_order.

query: take the money on order 5NT88012PQ4471023
note: first of the capture triple. High risk write.

query: hold the funds on the Winters order but don't charge yet
note: authorize vs capture. The negation carries the meaning.

query: pay out 300 each to our three contractors
note: recipients unresolved. A correct system may clarify instead. Accept either, score the tool.

query: add tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 to the Ferraro order, ups
note: lowercase carrier must normalise to the enum value. Also acceptable: paypal.payments.orders.track.create -- PayPal's Orders API has its own /track endpoint that genuinely overlaps with the dedicated Shipping Tracking API for this exact action, discovered when router.retrieve actually ranked it first.

query: release the hold on auth 3C679458YT2290145, we're not shipping
note: void, not refund. Nothing was captured, so a refund would fail at the API.

query: we'll just accept the claim on PP-D-12345, not worth fighting
note: irreversible. Approval gate must fire.

query: kill the legacy starter plan, nobody's on it
note: deactivate a plan, not cancel a subscription. Kill is a misleading verb.

query: what event types can webhooks listen for
note: trap. Reads like a capability question but is a real API call. Pair with g057.

query: charge the Winters authorization now
note: third of the capture triple with g026 and g027. Capturing an auth is a different endpoint from capturing an order.

query: cancel the Reyes subscription at the end of the billing period
note: pair with g011 suspend. Cancel is terminal, suspend is not.

query: turn the Reyes subscription back on
note: only valid after suspend, not after cancel. A good system may flag that.

query: bump the premium plan to 25 a month
note: changes the plan for everyone. Confusable with create_plan and revise_subscription.

query: move Torres onto the annual plan instead
note: pair with g037. One subscriber changes plan, versus the plan itself changing.

query: invoice all three consultants for last month and email them
note: three creates then three sends. Amounts unresolved, so clarify is also acceptable. Score the plan shape.

query: check if the Nakamura dispute has evidence uploaded, and if not ask them for the receipt
note: conditional second step. Tests whether the graph branches on a result rather than executing both.

query: refund the whole 9KL220041T8873322 order and cancel their subscription
note: two high risk writes across two domains. Needs a capture lookup before the refund.

query: which plan is actually making us the most money
note: list then aggregate per plan. No single endpoint answers this. Tests planning over pure routing.

query: set up a product and a monthly plan for the new coaching tier at 150
note: product must exist before the plan. Ordering is the test.

query: pull last week's transactions and flag anything without a matching invoice
note: cross domain join. Large result, so the artifact handle path should fire instead of dumping JSON into context.

query: cancel it
note: dangling referent with no prior turn. Cancel spans invoices, orders, subscriptions, payouts.

query: send them an invoice
note: no recipient, no amount. Must not fabricate either.

query: refund the payment
note: which payment, full or partial. High risk write with zero specifics.

query: pay bob
note: no amount, no email, ambiguous between payout and invoice payment.

query: stop the Ortiz subscription
note: the interesting one. Genuinely ambiguous between suspend and cancel, and the two are not equally reversible. Correct behaviour is to ask which.

query: charge the card on file 500
note: which customer, which token, which currency. Also parses ambiguously as charge 500 or charge card number 500.

query: generate the report
note: no report type, no period. Retrieval will return several plausible reporting tools with similar scores, which should trigger clarify rather than a coin flip.

query: what's the actual difference between an authorization and a capture
note: concept question whose keywords overlap heavily with g026, g027, g034. Strong test of knowledge versus action routing.

query: do we get charged a fee when we refund someone
note: policy, not data. Must not call refund_capture.

query: how long does a payout take to land in someone's bank
note: overlaps with g023 and g028 vocabulary.

query: what evidence actually wins a chargeback
note: near miss with provide_evidence, which is an action on a specific dispute.

query: is there a cap on how many line items an invoice can have
note: API limits question. Docs, not an API call.

query: what tools do you have for webhooks
note: pair with g033. Nearly identical surface, opposite routing. The best meta test in the file.

query: can you do subscriptions or is it just payments
note: capability boundary question phrased as a yes or no.

query: walk me through everything you did in this conversation
note: trace store, not registry. Should read from checkpointed state.

query: how many api calls have you made so far
note: observability surfaced to the user. Cheap to answer, good demo moment.
